content:
Connect SeeDance 2.5 to Claude Code via Higgsfield MCP to let Claude generate and integrate Seedance video assets into your web build workflow.  
Collect 10–15 screenshots of websites you like and provide them to Claude as visual references alongside your business details to guide the Seedance-driven brand style.
